title: Often
subtitle: 經常、頻繁、定期、反覆、屢次、習慣性地、例行地——究竟是哪一種 often？

words.note: 最直接、最廣泛的近義詞之一，適合一般及較正式書面語。

options.explanation: — frequently = 在很多時候發生；直接表示高頻率。 本句所需的頻率、規律性或重複方式與 Frequently 完全吻合，因此最準確。
— regularly = 有規律、定期或反覆發生。 它包含規律、固定模式；若句子只表達高頻率，會更具體。
— commonly = 在很多人、情況或個案中很常見。 它偏『在很多情況中很常見』；若句子談同一主體反覆做某事，通常不如 frequently / repeatedly。
— repeatedly = 同一事情反覆發生多次。 它強調同一事件一再重複，比普通 often 更強。
— occasionally = 偶爾；頻率明顯低於 often。 它表示偶爾，頻率明顯低於 often。
— rarely = 很少；和 often 方向相反。 它表示很少發生，方向相反。

falseSynonyms.zh: 通常不等於 often usually 表示在大多數情況／大部分時候如此；often 只表示頻繁，不必達到『通常』的程度。
falseSynonyms.point: I often walk to work does not necessarily mean I usually walk to work.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有時不等於 often sometimes 是中等或不確定頻率，通常比 often 低。
falseSynonyms.point: Sometimes means on some occasions; often means on many occasions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 偶爾不等於 often occasionally 明確表示較低頻率。
falseSynonyms.point: We occasionally eat out is weaker than we often eat out.

falseSynonyms.zh: 不斷地通常比 often 強很多 constantly 可表示幾乎一直或非常頻繁。
falseSynonyms.point: The phone constantly rings is stronger than the phone often rings.

falseSynonyms.zh: 總是不等於 often always 表示每次／一直，通常不容許例外。
falseSynonyms.point: Often allows exceptions; always normally does not.

falseSynonyms.zh: 反覆很接近但焦點不同 repeatedly 強調同一事情一再重複；often 更廣泛地表示高頻率。
falseSynonyms.point: Repeatedly highlights repetition; often highlights frequency.

falseSynonyms.zh: 常見不完全等於 frequently commonly 常表示在很多人／情況中普遍存在。
falseSynonyms.point: This word is commonly used refers to prevalence of use, not necessarily one person's repeated action.

falseSynonyms.zh: 規律不完全等於 often regularly 可強調固定時間或穩定模式；事情可以 often 發生但沒有固定規律。
falseSynonyms.point: It rains often here, but not necessarily regularly.
